key_insight: MARVEL improves out-of-distribution detection in imbalanced medical classification by combining nonlinear von Mises-Fisher experts with a margin-aware multi-expert design and an explicit outlier expert.
clinical_relevance: The method aims to reduce overconfident misclassification of unfamiliar cases, helping clinicians defer uncertain inputs more safely in real-world diagnostic workflows.
method: Nonlinear von Mises-Fisher classifier learns flexible decision boundaries beyond standard cosine-based models.
Margin-aware expert ensemble specializes across different parts of the long-tailed label distribution.
Outlier expert is trained to separate in-distribution from out-of-distribution inputs.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on RFMiD, ISIC2019, and NCTCRC, the approach reported mean FPR95 reductions of 8.45%, 13.02%, and 36.90% versus state-of-the-art methods.
watch_item: Results are promising, but clinical deployment still requires careful validation for dataset shift, calibration, and workflow integration across sites and populations.
paper_title: MARVEL: Margin-Aware Robust von Mises-Fischer Expert Learning for Long-Tailed Out-of-Distribution Detection
